title: Nuclear systems kept archaic so they can't be hacked
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Nuclear systems kept archaic so they can't be hacked, about c. 2017 at NORAD; black sites, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, I had talked about that and it was it was something I found out personally was that they keep it archaic because it's harder to hack.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, who says he once saw a 300 foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he found out personally that around 2017 the systems at NORAD, the military command that watches North American skies, and at secret military facilities were kept deliberately old fashioned. He says this is because outdated systems are harder to hack. He tells it as part of what he learned about how hidden military sites really run.
